episodes.synopsis:
Nakahito Kagura and a few friends of his decide to investigate an abandoned house.

Since Nakahito's family has a history of magic, they decide that Nakahito should go with them to take care of the rumoured mad-scientist living there.
episodes.title: The Activation

episodes.synopsis:
Dr. Amagi attempts to coerce Dr. Ayanokoji into working with the Japanese military.

Meanwhile, Amagi mistakenly grabs Nakahito and Kurumi has to rescue him.
episodes.title: A One-Master Kinda Gal

episodes.synopsis:
A new character by the name of Dr. Brandow joins the Imperial Army, even more interesting is it seems as though he has been previously part of the Steel Angel Project.

Meanwhile, Nakahito must now become accustom to rude awakenings, while Dr. Ayanokoji is convinced the Imperial Army will not be able to awaken the second Steel Angel prototype.
episodes.title: Cold Saki

episodes.synopsis:
The Imperial Army's preparation for the second Steel Angel's completion draws closer.

Meanwhile, Nakahito finds himself haunted by the words of Dr.Ayanakoji stating that only Nakahito has control over Kurumi.
episodes.title: Don't Hate Me!

episodes.synopsis:
As Kurumi finds herself forced into battle with Saki, she hesitates, giving Saki the upper hand.

In an effort to help, Nakahito seems to just make things worse and discovers that his words put Kurumi in this dilemma. As the fight continues it seems as though no one can help against the wrath of Saki.

What will be the final outcome?
episodes.title: Warm Saki

episodes.synopsis:
With the kidnapping of Dr. Ayanokoji it seems that in return a new (and unexpected) member has joined in his place.

Meanwhile, Saki quickly redeems herself as she helps to rebuild what she had at one point destroyed.
episodes.title: Love Shack

episodes.synopsis:
The group"s trip to Izumo comes to a halt when Nakahito gets a stomachache.

Meanwhile, Kurumi, Nakahito, and Amagi go see a doctor, but this doctor isn't your normal kind of doctor.
episodes.title: Playing Doctor

episodes.synopsis:
A large boulder is blocking the path of the train to our comrade’s destination, Dr. Amagi searches for other transportation while the army tries to remove the boulder.

Meanwhile, Nakahito learns more about Dr. Ayanakoji's past from Dr. Amagi.
episodes.title: Tsunami

episodes.synopsis: The group spends the night at a fireworks festival, but the sparks really fly when Nakahito is kidnapped and Kurumi sets off to find him.
episodes.title: Fireworks

episodes.synopsis: Kurumi finds herself fighting Nakahito's kidnappers, the Steel Angels Kaga, Tsunami, and Kaori.
episodes.title: Triple Threat

episodes.synopsis: A couple of incidents get Kurumi thinking that there is something going on between Nakahito and Saki.
episodes.title: Cinnamon Cookies

episodes.synopsis: Kurumi, Nakahito, and Dr. Amagi go to Kyoto to find Saki, who is beaten badly by another new Steel Angel, Karinka.
episodes.title: Karinka

episodes.synopsis: Kurumi fights Steel Angel Karinka. Can Kurumi's Mark II Angel Heart prevail over Karinka's two hearts?
episodes.title: Second Sister

episodes.synopsis: Karinka disguises herself and tries to find out Kurumi's secret.
episodes.title: It's Not Fair

episodes.synopsis: Karinka finds herself working as a waitress with Kurumi and Nakahito in an effort to find out the secret to Kurumi's power.
episodes.title: Dark Wings

episodes.synopsis: Karinka's new goal is to get a kiss from Nakahito so that she can become more powerful than Kurumi.
episodes.title: Our Lips Are Sealed

episodes.synopsis: Kurumi and the gang finally arrives in Izumo, where they learn many secrets about Dr. Ayanokoji. Also, Nakahito meets a young boy...
episodes.title: Mikhail

episodes.synopsis: Mikhail tells Nakahito about the potential danger of Kurumi's Angel Mark II Heart.
episodes.title: Lies

episodes.synopsis: Kurumi, Saki, Karinka, and Dr. Amagi arrive at the Academy Base to rescue Nakahito. However, the Steel Angels fall into the Academy's traps, and Dr. Amagi meets face-to-face with Dr. Walski.
episodes.title: Storming The Base

episodes.synopsis: An angered Kurumi continues her search for Nakahito, but she runs into and fights Steel Angel Mikhail.
episodes.title: Avenging Angel

episodes.synopsis: The battle between Kurumi and Mikhail continues. However, Kurumi is being consumed by demonic energy to the point that she grows black wings.
episodes.title: When Angels Die

episodes.synopsis: After beating Mikhail, the demonically possesed Kurumi attacks dr.Walski's base!
episodes.title: Hell's Angel

episodes.synopsis:
Kurumi (in demon possesion) attacks the academy base, the damage is fatal.

In order to stop Kurumi, all the steel angels drain themselves to the point of de-activation to power the ultimate weapon to stop Kurumi's destructive powers.
episodes.title: Crime and Punishment

episodes.synopsis: Nakahito makes one final attempt to stop Kurumi from destroying everything.
episodes.title: Kiss
